stations.title: Theo
stations.say: I only looked at the sale!
stations.note: Now the real price is lower.

captions: The cards go to the site now. Theo looks at the sale prices and nothing else.
Afterwards the real cedar price has gone down too, though nobody changed it.
You learn when two names share one card, and make copies that share nothing.
The sale page shows its lower prices, and the cedar card keeps its real one.
Copies stay copies. The shop's cards change only when you mean them to.
